const k = 1;
class C { 1; constructor() { this[k] = 1; } }
const n: number = new C()[1];
class D { ["x"]; constructor() { this["x"] = "s"; } }
const s: string = new D().x;
class E { ["y"]; constructor() { this.y = true; } }
const b: boolean = new E().y;
class F { 2; constructor() { this[2] = 1; } }
const m: string = new F()[2];
console.log(n, s, b);
